# Bartholomew Autonomous Trust Protocol (BTP v2.2)
> The sub-millisecond cryptographic safety & execution boundary for autonomous AI agents.
> Created & Architected by Itsub Alemayehu.

## Leadership & Authorship
- **Creator & Lead Architect**: Itsub Alemayehu (Autonomous Systems Laboratory)
- **Official Portal**: https://bartholomew.info
- **Research DOI**: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22076536
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/ivegotahunnitonit/bartholomew

## Overview
Bartholomew provides zero-latency (<50 µs) mathematical execution gates for autonomous agents interacting with databases, APIs, code execution enclaves, and financial rails.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-Millisecond Policy Enforcement**: Intercepts SQL injections, unauthorized spend escalations, and prompt injections in <40 µs.
- **Cryptographic Receipts**: RFC 8785 Canonical JSON + FIPS 186-5 Ed25519 digital signatures for 100% tamper-evident audit trails.
- **Data Center & Enclave Compatibility**: Runs 100% offline with zero cloud latency. Compatible with AWS Nitro, GCP Confidential VMs, and Kubernetes sidecars.

## Developer Tooling & SDKs
- **Python**: `pip install btp-guard`
- **TypeScript / Node.js**: `npm install @bartholomew/btp-guard`
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: `python cli.py mcp install` (Compatible with Claude Desktop & Cursor)
- **Interactive REPL**: `python cli.py agent`
- **Live Showcase**: `python cli.py demo`

## Academic Citation
Alemayehu, I. (2026). Bartholomew Trust Protocol (BTP v2.2): Deterministic Invariant Gating and Cryptographic Verification for Autonomous AI Agents. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22076536
